protocol.data_source: saved official 2023-2025 PDFs plus previously cached verified HTML; no HTTP403 retries
protocol.cohort: all structurally validated complete fields; unlinked horses retained with isolated source-row identity and zero cross-race history
protocol.unknown_official_IDs: remain NULL; never inferred official numbers
protocol.historical_availability: explicit 2-day and 7-day calendar assumptions, never PDF creation/modification time
protocol.payout_repair: ordered trifecta anchor, single/exacta/trio/wide checks, verify all original PDF hashes and reconcile overlapping HTML
protocol.evaluation_disclosure: 2025 already inspected; no claim of unseen holdout or live profitability
protocol.selection: 2024 mean log loss only; lower complexity on exact ties
protocol.reference_bet: maximum p times final odds >= 1.05; one 100-yen hypothetical win bet per race; horse-number tie break
protocol.promotion: research improvement requires lower paired log loss and higher same-rule final-odds return on both lag assumptions; never activate final-odds models for pre-off forecasts
protocol.performance_repair: recover one-decimal official finish times and same-time marks; explicit nonstarter/nonfinisher statuses; require complete field, monotonic times, complete odds and consistent payouts; keep ties and unknown states quarantined

risk_policy.selection: 2024 day-bootstrap lower 95% ROI bound, then mean ROI; approve only if lower bound >100; publish non-approved candidate as research only

protocol.corner_repair: full printed fourth-corner field with grouped midranks, HTML interval checks, omit ambiguous front/behind classification when group straddles 35%
